column4: レイが倒れる、今度は逃げる余力もなく瀕死
column5: Lei falls, now unable even to flee, near death.

column4: ピンチのレイをメアリー・アン(１０歳)が助ける
column5: Mary Ann (10 years old) rescues the troubled Lei.

column4: カオスで止めをさされるという所で、メアリーが飛び出し身を盾にしてレイを守る。
column5: As Chaos is about to deliver the finishing blow, Mary jumps out and shields Lei with her body.

column4: どけと言ってもどかない
column5: Even when told to move aside, she won't budge.

column4: 総統、女好きと聞く、わ・・私を抱くがよい、まだ未経験だぞ、　いやブスいらない
column5: Supreme Leader, I heard you like women. W-well, take me-I'm still inexperienced. No, never mind, I don't want an ugly one.

column4: すぐに美人になる、保証する、４年後私を抱く権利をやろう　いや、ブスのままだろからいらない
column5: She'll quickly become beautiful, I guarantee it. I'll give you the right to be with me in four years. No, you'll probably still be ugly, so forget it.

column4: ならどうしたら、こいつを助けてくれるんだ。
column5: Then what should I do for you to help this one?

column4: えっ、それは４年後私を抱く権利と引き替えにこの男の命を助けてやると
column5: Eh? So you mean you'll save this man's life in exchange for the right to be with me in four years?

column4: それはいい、いらん、だが助けてやる
column5: That's fine. No thanks, but I'll save him anyway.

column4: しかたないのでレイは捕縛、
column5: With no other choice, Lei is captured.

column4: 牢屋で縛られたレイとメアリー
column5: Lei and Mary are tied up in the jail cell.

column4: お友達になってあげると言ったでしょ。
column5: Didn't I say I'll be your friend?
